title: Power Rankings: Blazers break into top 5
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 5
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: This second straight 16-2 start by the Celts, so readily deemed inferior to the Lakers' start by so many readers, has been topped only twice in the past 10 seasons: Dallas in '02-03 (17-1) and the Lakers in '01-02 (16-1).
